description: Institutions inside the supervisory perimeter. The submitter of an authorisation dossier is always one of these — an agent operator is not a regulated entity anywhere, so the obligation attaches here. See docs/synthetic-data-spec.md Part 0.2.

institutions.notes: Processes card-not-present and agent-initiated commerce for mid-market merchants. Its Agentic Checkout API requires the mandate chain and run record as a condition of processing, which is why it can produce construction context it does not itself generate.
